Chat-based edits, free rollbacks, and a live URL - no re-quoting a redesign.", "targetKeyword": "ai website builder for freelancers", "category": "Personas", "bodyHtml": "

The problem: a fast draft, a thin budget

A client wants to see something before they commit - a landing page mockup, a small business site, a proof of concept for a new service. They want it fast, and they are not paying for three rounds of design revisions to get there. That is the actual shape of freelance work: the budget for a first draft is thin, the timeline is thinner, and every hour spent building a throwaway prototype is an hour not billed for finished work. Static mockup tools get you a picture of a site. Hand-coding a first draft gets you something real, but it eats the afternoon you needed for billable projects.

How Kodely fits the workflow

Kodely skips the mockup-then-rebuild cycle. You describe the site in plain English in a chat interface, and Kodely generates a real Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 app - actual component files, not a static image and not raw HTML you will end up rewriting later. A live preview renders the compiled app as it is built, so you and the client are looking at something real from the first message.

  • Revisions happen in chat, not in a new quote. If the client wants the hero section reworded or the layout rearranged, you describe the change and Kodely edits the actual components. You are not re-scoping a redesign every time feedback comes in.
  • Rollback is free. Every successful generation is a checkpoint. If a requested change makes the site worse, roll back and try a different direction at no cost.
  • The code is visible. Open the code view at any point to see and copy the actual generated source files if you want to hand-tune something yourself.

Where freelancers are actually using it

Three concrete cases come up constantly:

  • A landing page draft for a pitch meeting. Instead of walking into a prospect meeting with a slide deck, describe their business and show up with a working page on a live URL. It costs you fifteen minutes, not a design sprint.
  • A personal portfolio that actually gets updated. Freelancers use Kodely to build or refresh their own portfolio site since editing it is a chat message, not a weekend project - which means it actually gets kept current.
  • A quick site for a small client project. Plenty of client work is just one small marketing or informational site. For those jobs, Kodely gets you from brief to a published, real site fast, so more of the job's budget stays margin instead of build time.

Pricing: the same for everyone

There is no freelancer tier, no agency discount, and no plan to upgrade into. Every account runs on the same credit system, and credits are metered from the actual AI cost of each generation - a build that fails to compile is never charged.

Credits never expire, so a slow month does not cost you anything you have already paid for.

Worth knowing before you pitch it to a client

Kodely builds frontend sites - no backend, database, auth, or payments generation yet, and no click-to-edit visual editor, only chat-based edits. Publishing puts the site live on a free name.kodely.site subdomain; custom domains are not supported yet. There is no zip export or code download today - you can see and copy the source in-app, but there is nothing to hand off as a file. For fast drafts, portfolios, and small marketing sites, none of that gets in the way. For a client who needs a login system or a database on day one, set expectations accordingly.

Start building

The fastest way to know if this fits your workflow is to describe your next client site and watch it get built.
